mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.category_id, c.name AS category_name, s.title, s.description, s.status, s.active_version_id, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM scenario s JOIN scenario_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.id, s.category_id, c.name AS category_name, s.title, s.description, s.status, s.active_version_id, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM scenario s JOIN scenario_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active_version_id IS NOT NULL AND c.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY s.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scenario (category_id, title, description, status) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE scenario SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE scenario SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE scenario SET status = 'ACTIVE', active_version_id = #{activeVersionId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
